scope: simulation and machine-readable summaries only; no figures and no manuscript text

pairing_rule: For each DGP and replication, generate one 60-month path; the 24-month history is its first 24 months.
training_validation_rule: Chronological split: first floor(0.8*n) months for candidate fitting, remaining months for validation; refit the selected numerical threshold on all n months.

selection_methods.TAIL_LEGACY_LOG: V1.2 no-upper TAIL selection: 2,000 simulated monthly maxima, Scott Gaussian KDE log score, raw 0.10*abs(xi-median_xi) penalty, original tie rule.
selection_methods.CV_LOG_ZPEN: Same candidate set, folds, hard gates and log score; standardize oriented candidate scores within history, then subtract the common dimensionless xi-stability penalty.
selection_methods.CV_FZ0_ZPEN: Average upper-tail FZ0 score across p* in {0.5238095238, 0.5833333333, 0.95}; standardize and apply the common xi-stability penalty.
selection_methods.CV_TQCRPS_ZPEN: Average normalized upper-tail quantile score across the same three p* values, integrating tau from each p* to 0.99 on a fixed 41-point grid; standardize and apply the common xi-stability penalty. This is a prespecified tail-quantile-score adaptation, not a claim of exact reproduction of Hoga et al.'s implementation.
selection_methods.CV_COST_ZPEN: For each candidate, derive its tariff action from the training-fit law; score realized validation bills, average within each tariff family over its fixed cells, then equally average the three families; standardize and apply the common xi-stability penalty.
selection_methods.EVENT_EMP: V1.2 event-level empirical monthly-maximum construction, fitted on all n months.
selection_methods.EMP: Empirical distribution of the n monthly maxima.

tariff_families.cell_source: V1.2 saved high-pstar design grid; fixed here before EXP1 outcomes

decision_and_inference.capacity_reference: S = exact DGP mean / prespecified utilization; this defines the simulation tariff only and is not supplied to fitted estimators except as a tariff input.
decision_and_inference.primary_loss: oracle expected monthly bill of the fitted procedure's action minus oracle-optimal expected monthly bill, evaluated under the known DGP
decision_and_inference.mode_error: indicator that fitted procedure tariff mode differs from the unique DGP oracle mode
decision_and_inference.paired_unit: replication history; 24- and 60-month estimates are paired within DGP by shared first-24-month path
decision_and_inference.contrast_sign: mean regret(method) - mean regret(baseline); negative favors method
decision_and_inference.selection_error_decomposition: best full-refit risk among gate-admissible threshold candidates minus full oracle risk; selected candidate risk minus best candidate risk
decision_and_inference.mcse: paired replication-level standard error; do not treat tariff cells as independent units

pilot_gate.extension_rule: Estimate paired contrast SD from the first 100 replications; before viewing direction/significance, compute the fixed total R needed for MCSE <= 0.10 times the prespecified reference scale (median oracle monthly bill across cells). If R<=200, extend to that fixed R; if R>200, stop the pilot and redesign precision plan. Never select cells or claims by significance.
